# Outputs of cif2qewan 0.2.0

`scf.in` and `pwscf.win` generated by cif2qewan 0.2.0 (the `master` branch,
commit 4bc648f) from the `cif_scf.in`, `mp-13_Fe.cif` and options of the
example of the same name under `examples/`, with an existing `cif_scf.in` in
the working directory (0.2.0 reused it instead of running cif2cell).

These are the only two generated files whose text changed in 0.3.0:
`scf.in` writes `K_POINTS {automatic}` instead of the `K_POINTS automatic`
copied from cif2cell, and `pwscf.win` lists the keywords in a fixed layout.
The other seven files (`nscf.in`, `pw2wan.in`, `check_wannier/nscf.in`,
`band/nscf.in`, `band/band.in`, `band/proj.in`, `band/pp.in`) of every
example are byte for byte the 0.2.0 output, so the reference examples
themselves pin them; `tests/test_examples.py` checks both.
